substudy: Route2 Substudy 1 - Cross-Artifact Portability Stability Check

claims.evidence_summary: QA/evidence gating remains dominant in LoRA, LoHa, and checkpoint delta under perturbed panel composition.
claims.interpretation_note: Workflow-level evidence gating is robust to local panel substitutions.

claims.evidence_summary: Conservative narrowing remains visible across classes (retained subset reduction or QA-bound suppression).
claims.interpretation_note: Broad-to-narrow workflow shape remains a sturdy cross-artifact invariant.

claims.evidence_summary: Same-task vs cross-task separation still holds where testable (LoRA, checkpoint delta), but LoHa remains indeterminate.
claims.interpretation_note: Task-relation ordering remains directionally useful but still coverage-limited.

claims.evidence_summary: Checkpoint delta preserves same-family intermediate ordering, but perturbed LoRA does not show strict intermediate placement.
claims.interpretation_note: Same-family distinctness survives, but strict intermediate ordering is sensitive to local case substitutions and evidence regime.

claims.evidence_summary: No new cross-artifact structural metric emerges; factor geometry remains unavailable on checkpoint summary representation.
claims.interpretation_note: Representation locality of strongest structural metrics remains stable.

claims.evidence_summary: Near-miss remains explicit in LoRA and only partial/queued in checkpoint triage, absent in LoHa panel.
claims.interpretation_note: Perturbation does not resolve optional/near-miss portability across artifact classes.
